page.overview:
Who is Tow Mater?

Sir Tow Mater [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Order_of_the_British_Empire MBE], simply known as Mater, is one of the main characters of the Cars franchise. He also appears in the short series Cars Toons: Mater's Tall Tales as the main character.

Mater is a brown, former baby blue, 1955 Haulital Hook'em and Lightning McQueen's best friend. One of his favorite activities is to go Tractor Tipping at night, as it's his favorite hobby. Mater's catchphrases are "Dad gum!", "If I'm lyin', I'm cryin'!", and "Git-R-Done!" (the last one being his voice actor's signature phrase).

Mater is completely unique. He is a buck-toothed tow truck that bucks every trend and certainly does not tow the line. Although he is perhaps not the clearest vehicle in Radiator Springs, Mater has a wicked sense of humor and an even bigger sense of fun. If any car spends time with the tow truck, he/she will soon find him/herself hooked, whether he is scaring tractors, driving backwards at incredible speed, or teasing Lightning McQueen about being keen on Sally. Very popular with the residents of Radiator Springs, Mater is always there to help his friends and pull them through any crisis.

Once Mater was a young, shiny blue tow truck, but these days he could do with a generous helping of Rust-eze and a fresh coat of paint. One would have to peer closely to see his original colors.
